plain: Similar enough in some way to be compared

webster.text: Having analogy; bearing some resemblance or proportion; followed by to; as, there is something in the exercise of the mind analogous to that of the body.

example.quote: And instead of being analogous to the power of declaring war, it affords a striking illustration of the incompatibility of the two powers in the same hands.
example.cite: James Madison, Helvidius No. I, Aug. 24, 1793
